text:
neha: Quick idea 4a1 - run a monthly SI "skill-share" lab where an SI shows a real integration (marketplace listing, auth handshake, or hw bringup) end-to-end. Low-ceremony, recorded, open to other SIs to ask follow-ups. Thoughts?

ryan: Love it. Peers teaching peers is high ROI. Keep it 40m demo + 20m troubleshooting.

emily: +1. Could alternate focus each month: marketplace onboarding, dedicated infra, on-prem networking, driver tuning.

neha: Exactly. Also want to tie labs to a "practical badge" - small checklist partners complete to get a green check in the portal. Not a full cert, just proves they did the lab.

ryan: For logistics - hosts should submit a short template: topic, duration, pre-reqs, assets (slides/gist), and test case. We can publish on the partner calendar.

tina: We should require a sanitized recording policy for SIs that demo customer setups. Partner ops can scrub hostnames/IPs before publish.

emily: Ops tool can auto-redact via regex for IPs/domains. We'll coordinate with legal for the consent blurb in the signup flow.

partner-bot: Note: calendar placeholder created: "SI Skill-Share Lab" first slot 2025-05-07 09:00 PT. Signup: https://forms.gle/skillshare-sample.

neha: Nice. Action items: I'll draft the host template + badge checklist. Ryan you can wrangle the calendar + portal display. Tina pls propose the recording redaction steps. Emily check legal blurb.

ryan: Happy to do calendar + portal. Portal needs two small fields: "Skill-Share badge: yes/no" and "lab assets link". I'll add them to the partner profile API.

tina: I'll draft a short playbook: 1) pre-approve assets, 2) scrub PII, 3) publish recording with notes/timestamps. Will include a small script for renaming mounts and masking IPs. Example snippet: 
```
# mask IPs
sed -E 's/([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[REDACTED_IP]/g' session_notes.md > scrubbed_notes.md
```

emily: Legal says we need explicit opt-in on the form and a checkbox for each guest when they join. Also require a brief non-confidential summary in the publish metadata.

neha: Ok let's build minimal friction: host opts in, partner signs consent on signup, recording is scrubbed then published with summary + timestamps. Badge awarded after partner uploads proof (gist linking to their lab config + one test result).

ryan: For marketplace-focused labs, include a short demo showing the listing YAML and the health check endpoint. Could reuse the example from the docs.

neha: Good call. I'll prototype the first lab (marketplace listing + healthcheck) and volunteer ACME SI as a mock host.

tina: ACME ok with mock data only? Confirm before recording.

partner-bot: Reminder: please add host template and consent language to the signup form by 2025-04-18.

emily: I'll push legal blurb by EOD tomorrow.

ryan: Will update portal fields and calendar this week.

neha: Great. Tentative dry-run with hosts + ops 2025-04-28 09:30 PT. If that works, we'll advertise the first lab for 2025-05-07. :tada:

emily: Works for me.

ryan: Works.

neha: Thanks all. I'll post the host template here when ready.
